card.text: HAT-P-5 b was found in 2007 by HATNet as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-5b"
sources.quote: HAT-P-5 b is a transiting extrasolar planet located approximately 1000 light-years away in the constellation of Lyra, orbiting the star HAT-P-5.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Chasoň. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HAT-P-5b"
sources.quote: It is a hot Jupiter with a mass 6% greater than Jupiter and a radius 26% greater than Jupiter, corresponding to a density of 0.66 g/cm3, which is less than water.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
